name: Hotel Clio, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Denver Cherry Creek
positioning: Hotel Clio, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Denver Cherry Creek: a city hotel in Denver's walkable Cherry Creek neighborhood, with marble bathrooms, select Rocky Mountain view rooms and Cherry Creek North shopping and galleries right outside
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Cherry Creek North's shops, restaurants and galleries
Families who want spacious rooms in central Denver

facts.text: The hotel is in Cherry Creek, one of Denver's most walkable neighborhoods.
Stepping outside the hotel puts guests in Cherry Creek North, an outdoor retail and dining destination with a collection of art galleries.
Rooms have five-piece marble bathrooms with signature Clio bathrobes.
Room amenities include a Lavazza espresso machine and complimentary bottled water.
The one-bedroom suites have a king bed, a spacious living area, a powder room and an oversized soaking tub.
Rooms are spacious, with writing desks, a seating area and more than 400 square feet.
Toro Latin Kitchen & Lounge follows Central and South American convivial dining, with a ceviche bar, small plates and family-style entrees.
The 24-hour fitness center features Peloton bikes and Hydro rowers.
Through partnerships, guests can do vertical climbing at Studio CLMBR, interval training at Barry's Bootcamp and workouts at SoulCycle.
The Denver Botanic Gardens, a 23-acre park, is within walking distance of the hotel.
The Cherry Creek Trail passes through the heart of the Cherry Creek neighborhood.
Complimentary cribs are available on request, and families can ask for a king room with a queen-sized sofa sleeper.

highlights.text: Select guest rooms have unobstructed views of the Rocky Mountains.
Twice a week the concierge team leads guests on a guided walking tour of Cherry Creek.
Butler pantries on each floor provide still and sparkling water on tap.
Toro offers a ceviche making class with Executive Chef Oscar Padilla every Friday.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of Luxury Collection properties.
